newsitem.title: JAPAN: Murdoch says in talks to buy L.A. Dodgers.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch says in talks to buy L.A. Dodgers.

text.p: Media tycoon Rupert Murdoch confirmed Wednesday that he is negotiating to buy the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team.

"We are interested in the Dodgers," Murdoch, in Tokyo to launch News Corp.'s Japanese digital satellite broadcasting venture, told a news conference. "Other media companies now in America have great sporting teams."
Murdoch said he was in discussions with L.A. Dodgers President Peter O'Malley on the deal, but declined to comment on the price or any other details of the potential purchase.
"That's approximately what Mr. O'Malley and I have been talking about. I can't say more than that," he said.

The sale, if completed, would reportedly be worth $350 million, and could top $400 million if Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles and the club's Florida spring training facilities at Dodger Town are included in the deal.
On Tuesday, the Dodgers sought permission from the Major League Baseball Executive Council to enter serious discussions with the Fox Group, a unit of Murdoch's News Corp., on a possible sale.
Time Warner Inc. now owns the Atlanta Braves, which it acquired when it bought CNN from its founder, Ted Turner.
